title: Service Availability & SLA Disclosures
shortSummary: Describes operational availability commitments and infrastructure maintenance policies.

sections.heading: 1. Service Availability Disclosure
paragraphs: Histeria continuously monitors database and application health via an automated status checking system.

No formal financial Service Level Agreement (SLA) or uptime guarantee is currently published for standard accounts. Planned maintenance windows will be communicated via dashboard alerts where practical.
